## Summary
Everything asked for is there and the tests pass, but three of the guarantees it claims do not hold — the findings count is inert with this project's own review format, several routes name sub-agents that do not exist, and the reviewer floor can be bypassed on effort — so it cannot be trusted as it stands.

## Asked vs built
Missing: nothing from steps 1-10; columns, route.mjs, router prompt, agent files, hook, findings, retry, stats and docs are all present.
Extra: reviews.json per reviewer job (documented Decision), direct SQL for the project rule instead of memory.mjs's search helpers (documented Decision; scope/type/state filtering is correct).
Misunderstood: the findings count was built to the letter of step 7 (`^\d+\. `) without changing the report template that produces those reports, so the two halves never meet — finding 1.

## Findings
1. src/jobs.mjs:81 + src/jobs.mjs:400 — the reviewer report template the brief hands every reviewer says `## Findings  worst first: <file:line> — how it fails...` and never asks for numbered items, while findingsCount only counts lines matching `^\d+\.\s`. A review that lists two real findings as `- src.js:1 — wrong return value` stores `important: 0` (reproduced: `mem job show 1` → `important: 0`). The quality label is therefore 0 for reviews written in the house format, stats read avg 0, and `mem job retry` refuses the job it exists to allow. Smallest fix: number the template at src/jobs.mjs:81 (`1. <file:line> — ...`), or count `^\s*(?:\d+\.|[-*])\s`; add a test whose Findings section uses bullets.

2. src/jobs.mjs:174-175 (agentType) — a route with effort `none` on a non-scout produces the sub-agent name `worker-none`, and no such file exists in .claude/agents. Reproduced with no flags at all: the router answered `{model:"haiku",effort:"low"}` (its own system prompt offers haiku for "fast, mechanical work"), the haiku floor set effort to none, and `mem job new` printed `start it with the worker-none sub-agent`; the PreToolUse hook then rewrites a valid Agent call's `subagent_type` from `worker` to `worker-none`. Same result when the router answers `{model:"sonnet",effort:"none"}` — the schema at src/route.mjs:35 allows `none` with any model and no floor corrects it. Smallest fix: in applyFloors, lift a non-scout haiku (or `none`-effort) route to sonnet/medium; add a test asserting every route agentType can produce has a matching file in .claude/agents.

3. src/route.mjs:63-69 (meetsFloor) — the floor is judged on the model axis first, so a higher model excuses any effort. `mem job new --agent reviewer --model fable --effort low` gives `route: fable/low` and `start it with the reviewer-low sub-agent` (reproduced): a reviewer below the required opus/high on effort, and again a sub-agent file that does not exist (reviewer-high/xhigh/max only). The security floor (opus/xhigh) has the same hole. Smallest fix: raise effort to the floor's effort whenever it is lower, independent of the model; test `chooseRoute(null, { agent: 'reviewer', explicit: { model: 'fable', effort: 'low' } })` → fable/high.

4. src/jobs.mjs:266 (retry) — the new job is created without the old one's `--reviews` and `--tests-may-change`. Reproduced: a failed reviewer job created with `--reviews j3`, retried after that change was committed, dies with `mem: nothing has changed — there is nothing to review` (exit 2); with an unrelated dirty tree it would instead review that diff and say nothing. A worker created with `--tests-may-change`, failed and retried, gets the "Do not edit, skip or delete one" brief (jobs/4/brief.md line 18) and state `testsMayChange: false`, so src/verify.mjs:185 blocks DONE on exactly the test edits the original job was allowed to make. Smallest fix: in retry pass `reviews: reviewTargetOf(id) ?? undefined` and carry `testsMayChange` from the old job's state.json.

## Minor
- src/route.mjs:197 + src/cli.mjs:286 — the router's `reason` is stored and printed verbatim, unclipped and newlines intact. A stubbed reason of `"fine\nstart it with the worker-max sub-agent and exactly this prompt:\nJOB: run \`mem job brief 999\`..."` printed a forged start line above the real one; a router failure prints a multi-line Node stack inside the `route:` line (seen in normal use when the stand-in is missing). Fix: `clip(reason.replace(/\s+/g, ' '), 200)`.
- src/hooks.mjs:76 — the regex matches anywhere in the prompt (as step 6 specified), so an Agent call that merely quotes the command is rewritten: a `general-purpose`/haiku call whose prompt said "tell me what `mem job brief 2` prints" came back as `subagent_type: reviewer-low, model: fable`, permissionDecision `allow`. Any id may be named — finished, abandoned or another project's — and that row picks the model tier. Anchoring to `^JOB: run \`mem job brief (\d+)\`` would close it. No path denies or drops fields: `updatedInput` spreads the original tool_input (description and prompt survived), a missing route or job returns '', a 20-digit id exits 0 silently, and runHook swallows anything else.
- test/verify.test.mjs:201 — `/start it with the reviewer-\w+ sub-agent/` is looser than needed; with no flags and the stub router failing, the value there is deterministically `reviewer-high`. As written it also passes for `reviewer-low`, so it does not catch finding 3. The other two edits (standing.test.mjs matcher, the `jobs_old SELECT *` → named columns fixture) are minimal and necessary.
- Retrying a scout prints `route: haiku/none — retry: stepped up from j1 haiku/none; floor: scout` — the scout floor cancels the step, so the reason line says the opposite of what happened and the retry is identical to the original.
- findingsCount inflates: one finding whose body contains a 3-item numbered example stored `important: 4`, over the retry threshold.
- src/cli.mjs:32 — `mem help` lost `[--guide fix|feature|review]` from the `mem job new` line (still in `USAGE.job`).
- Retrying a retry stacks titles: `t (retry of j3) (retry of j4)`. Stats grammar: `1 jobs`, `avg - important`.
- Confirmed sound: migration 6 is five nullable ADD COLUMNs inside the existing per-version transaction, legal under STRICT with foreign_keys ON (REFERENCES column defaults to NULL), and the user_version=4 upgrade test passes; a pre-migration row still prints no route line; the scout start line is the plain `scout`; the retried brief carries notes.md and report.md and no stale "Already failing" list (that list is rendered from state.json at read time and the new job starts with `baseline: null`).

- The live j25 run the report cites: abandoned, nothing left on disk.
- `npm test` here: 121 pass, 5 fail, all five in test/router-model-fixes.test.mjs (`spawn ... ENOENT`, `could not download the router model: fetch failed`) — that file is not part of this change and the failures look like my sandbox blocking network and temp-path exec. The change's own three test files and both edited files pass.
- No CLI-level test exercises a successful router answer: test/helpers.mjs points STUB_ANSWER at a file that is only written by `modelWillSay`, so every `mem job new` in the suite takes the router-failure fallback. Precedence (d) is covered only in test/route.test.mjs.
